content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To boost your car's horsepower, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Install high-flow fuel injectors (2 hours)
Step 2. Mount a larger intercooler (4 hours)
Step 3. Dyno-tune the engine control unit (6 hours)
Step 4. Install a cold air intake system (1 hour)
Step 5. Purchase a high-performance fuel pump (30 minutes)
Step 6. Remove the restrictive factory exhaust manifold (3 hours)
Step 7. Flash the initial base map to the ECU (20 minutes)
Step 8. Conduct a final high-speed test run (30 minutes)
Step 9. Wrap the new headers with heat tape (1 hour)
Step 10. Inspect the turbocharger wastegate (45 minutes)
Step 11. Replace the spark plugs with a colder heat range (1 hour)
Step 12. Connect the OBD-II diagnostic tool (5 minutes)
Step 13. Clean the throttle body (30 minutes)
Step 14. Jack up the car and secure it on jack stands (20 minutes)
Step 15. Change the engine oil to full synthetic (45 minutes)
Step 16. Drain the radiator coolant (15 minutes)
Step 17. Research compatible tuning software (3 days)
Step 18. Upgrade the ignition coils (1 hour)
Step 19. Order a custom stainless steel downpipe (1 week)
Step 20. Source a high-flow fuel rail (2 days)
Step 21. Check for vacuum leaks (30 minutes)
Step 22. Buy a comprehensive professional toolkit (4 hours)
Step 23. Order performance-grade gaskets (3 days)
Step 24. Degrease the engine bay (1 hour)
Step 25. Clean the workspace and organize bolts (1 hour)
Step 26. Install a high-flow catalytic converter (2 hours)
Step 27. Replace the fuel filter (40 minutes)
Step 28. Bolt on the new exhaust headers (3 hours)
Step 29. Consult with a professional mechanic for a plan (2 hours)
Step 30. Install a turbocharger heat shield (20 minutes)
Step 31. Replace the air filter element (10 minutes)
Step 32. Fill the tank with 93-octane premium fuel (15 minutes)
Step 33. Install a high-pressure fuel regulator (1 hour)
Step 34. Install the new performance exhaust system (5 hours)
Step 35. Purchase a set of iridium spark plugs (1 hour)
Step 36. Calibrate the throttle position sensor (15 minutes)
Step 37. Download the manufacturer's service manual (10 minutes)
Step 38. Verify all hose clamps are tightened (30 minutes)
Step 39. Perform a compression test on all cylinders (1 hour)
Step 40. Refill the cooling system with fresh coolant (20 minutes)
